stem.text: An elastic cord of unstretched total length $16.0\,\text{cm}$ and cross-sectional area $2.0 \times 10^{-6}\,\text{m}^{2}$ is held horizontally by two smooth pins a distance $8.0\,\text{cm}$ apart.
The cord obeys Hooke's law. A load of mass $0.40\,\text{kg}$ is suspended centrally on the cord. The angle between the two sides of the cord supporting the load is $60^{\circ}$.
